STOCK_B1500.desc: baseline with 5x slice (budget control for A5)

A_NOBLOCK.desc: (a) no block copy at all: bytewise LD/ST only

A5_NOBLOCK_B1500.desc: (a') no block copy, 5x slice (removes the budget confound)

B_EXPLEN.desc: (b) block copy with BC=0 copies nothing (no 65,536 long count)

C_NOWRAP.desc: (c) data addresses full 16-bit, no wrap: the 7-bit alias trick fails

D_HARV_HALT.desc: (d) Harvard: pc leaving its own half stops the context

D2_HARV_WRAP.desc: (d') Harvard: pc wraps inside its own half

E_REGRAND.desc: (e) entry registers+flags uniform random per interaction

F_ROTATE.desc: (f) tape rotated by r~U[0,128) per interaction

G_BLOCK_OWN.desc: (g) partner half read-only to block ops (bytewise stores allowed)

H_RELADDR.desc: (h) pointers and JP targets are offsets from own base
